newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha prices stifled by lack of demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha prices stifled by lack of demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Wednesday as slow demand surpressed the potentially bullish effects of higher crude prices, trder said.

"It's been pretty slow on naphtha so far this week," said a broker. "You'd think it would be higher on the crude gains but people are still talking $199.50/$200 for April swaps which shows just how quiet it is."
March swaps were quoted at $197.50/$198.50 cif NWE while April was assessed at $199.50/$200 cif NWE.
On the cargo market prices were assessed $193/$197 on a cif basis.
Traders said a small cargo earmarked for an eastern destination was done at $193 cif NWE on Tuesday.
Barges were assessed at around $183/$185 fob ARA, but traders said it was very quiet.
